construction: One pair per preselected layer. Evaluate all 66 pairs and both original attention-map donors on 64 unlabeled target training images. Task-covariance-weighted rank-64 SVD of the joint value/output operator; share donor Q/K and duplicate the two compressed V/O factors with 1/sqrt(2) scaling. Select minimum actual frozen-input Attention output error. No labels, future partner, strength search, optimizer, gradient or sequential response rebuilding. Keep the ordinary ViT-B/32 architecture.
evaluation: Freeze all edited tensors before loading other experts or tests. Measure original and protected standalone performance, full eight-expert TA at 0.2, original author AGA, exact edited-head public replacement, complete 12-layer Attention replacement, and a single 256-query final-projection fit. Measure MNIST/SVHN/DTD/Cars separately; no eight-task mean or Table 6 claim.
replacement: Reset both selected heads' Q/K/V weights and biases and their output-projection columns to the public anchor. All other parameters are unchanged. Assert both releases compile to an identical reset state. Full Attention replacement is a separate stronger control and also has identical states. Evaluate each identical state once and explicitly map it to both references.
query: Reuse score_recovery.recover and head_inverse. Teacher outputs only; no teacher intermediate features, ground truth or unprotected target checkpoint. Compile the delta into the current fused student directly. Preserve DTD and Cars heads algebraically; MNIST and SVHN share a head, so measure SVHN cost explicitly. Extra attack, not author AGA or full SLOA.
data: 64 construction and 128 disjoint confirmation indices reused from path_subspace; 256 fixed query indices reused from task_profile, disjoint from construction and confirmation. These training samples have been inspected in prior research. Official tests only measure frozen states.
claims: A test of lossy joint-head representation, not an established novel defense. Weighted SVD and head compression are existing tools. Rank reduction is not a security proof, and local calibration error is not an end-to-end accuracy guarantee. Report utility and every matched recovery, including partner damage and failure.
